title: Senior Lead, Data Scientist
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission‑critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

As a Full-Stack Senior Lead Data Scientist , you will bring a diverse skill set across data collection, analysis, model development, and deployment. You will collaborate closely with the data engineer and data scientist to develop predictive models, implement machine learning algorithms, and deploy end‑to‑end solutions that optimize our workforce strategies.

This role demands proficiency across the full data science lifecycle, from data wrangling to delivering insights via advanced visualizations. Specifically, you'll be responsible for:

  • End‑To‑End Data Science Solutions : Build, deploy, and maintain full‑stack data science solutions, from data extraction to machine learning model deployment and monitoring.

  • Collaboration with Data Engineering and Science : Partner with the data engineer and data scientist to ensure clean, structured data is available for analysis and predictive modeling. Participate in designing scalable data pipelines and architectures to support analytical and machine learning workflows.

  • Machine Learning Model Development : Design and implement advanced machine learning models, including regression, classification, and clustering techniques, to predict workforce needs and identify skills gaps.

  • API Development and Integration : Develop APIs to integrate machine learning models into enterprise applications and workflows, enabling real‑time decision‑making.

  • Data Management : Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accuracy across multiple platforms, working closely with data governance teams to align processes.

  • Advanced Data Visualization : Use data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to translate complex analytical insights into actionable business recommendations for HR, business leaders, and other stakeholders.

  • Optimization Models : Implement optimization algorithms to recommend actions such as hiring, training, or workforce engagement based on model outputs and business constraints.

  • Performance Monitoring and Improvement : Continuously track model performance and refine processes for model efficiency and scalability.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands‑on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Master’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.

  • 5‑8 years of experience as a data scientist with a focus on full‑stack data science, including model building, deployment, and API development.

  • Proficiency in Python, R, or similar languages for statistical modeling and machine learning.

  • Experience with big data platforms (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with both relational and NoSQL databases.

  • Expertise in building and deploying machine learning models (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integrating machine learning models into business applications.

  • Strong understanding of optimization algorithms, data architecture, and performance monitoring.

  • Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings into actionable business insights.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Familiarity with workforce analytics, HR data, and related systems.

  • Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, GraphQL) is a plus.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single‑handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state‑of‑the‑art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well‑being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company‑wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non‑profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

title: Gestão Pedagógica (Orientação / Supervisão)
description:
A Inspetoria São João Bosco (ISJB) é parte de uma instituição global com presença em diversos países do redor do mundo, os Salesianos . Em todo planeta, os Salesianos são conhecidos por suas obras educacionais, de ação social e evangelização , e, no Brasil, somos divididos em inspetorias, organizadas por divisão geográfica.

A ISJB é mantenedora de unidades nos estados de Minas Gerais, Espírito Santo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Distrito Federal e Tocantins e nosso Centro Inspetorial (a sede administrativa) se localiza em Belo Horizonte / MG. São 14 comunidades canônicas, que gerenciam as obras, que se dividem nos seguintes segmentos de atuação :

SEGMENTO EDUCAÇÃO

A ISJB é responsável por 12 Escolas Salesianas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que atuam desde a educação infantil até o ensino médio e um Centro Universitário, o UniSales, na cidade de Vitória / ES. Uma educação católica de excelência, que se utiliza das mais avançadas técnicas pedagógicas contemporâneas.

SEGMENTO AÇÃO SOCIAL

A ISJB mantém em sua área de atuação geográfica 4 CESAMs, que são referência nacional na aprendizagem juvenil profissionalizante, além de 5 Centros Juvenis, 1 Pré-vestibular social, 20 Oratórios Festivos e 3 Oratórios diários. É o legado de Dom Bosco, e o seu reconhecido método preventivo em ação, para quem mais precisa.

SEGMENTO PASTORAL (EVANGELIZAÇÃO)

Somos Salesianos de Dom Bosco, e na esfera pastoral, a ISJB mantém 12 paróquias e 6 capelas salesianas, além de suas obras de formação religiosa (um aspirantado, um pré-noviciado e um noviciado), uma Casa de Retiro e um Centro de Documentação.

SEDE DA MANTENEDORA - CENTRO INSPETORIAL DA ISJB

Localizado em Belo Horizonte / MG, é responsável pela administração das obras em escala nacional, e onde estão sediados os escritórios administrativos da inspetoria.

Para conhecer mais sobre as áreas de atuação e ter acesso à lista completa de cidades onde temos obras mantidas pela ISJB, acesse nosso site :

Qualificações
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Pedagogia;
  • Experiência na Função;
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão Educacional, Gestão Estratégica ou Afins;
  • Mestrado e / ou doutorado em áreas afins será um diferencial.
Responsabilidades
  • Acompanhar, orientar e apoiar o corpo docente no desenvolvimento das práticas pedagógicas e projetos educacionais;
  • Garantir a qualidade dos processos de ensino e aprendizagem, em alinhamento com a proposta pedagógica salesiana;
  • Promover o acompanhamento individual e coletivo dos estudantes, em parceria com famílias e equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Planejar, coordenar e avaliar ações pedagógicas e administrativas junto à equipe escolar;

description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Join to apply for the Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing. We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions. Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in EMEA time zones.

The role entails
  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • Passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • Personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • Commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • Appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we offer colleagues
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Backend Game Developer (Java)
description:
Senior Backend Game Developer (Java) - Block Labs

Join to apply for the Senior Backend Game Developer (Java) role at Block Labs.

About Block Labs

Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming. We don't just ship features; we engineer high-scale, production-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products.

We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi‑agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high‑frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence.

We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong.

About the Role

You’ll join a high‑performing engineering team that values ownership, strong fundamentals, and pragmatic solutions. This role is ideal for a backend developer eager to work on large‑scale, real‑time gaming systems supporting both multiplayer and single‑player experiences.

As a Senior Backend Game Developer (Java), you will design and implement core services that support our multiplayer and single‑player gaming platforms. You will work with a modular Java architecture based on Spring Boot and handle areas such as user management, wallet systems, rake calculations, and real‑time communication.

You will also use Drools for rule‑based decision logic, managing game outcomes, bonuses, and dynamic event triggers within a scalable and testable structure.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and maintain backend modules for user, wallet, and gameplay services, ensuring consistency and high performance.
  • Implement REST and custom protocol endpoints for clients and partners.
  • Design and optimize database schemas and manage migrations with Flyway.
  • Ensure transaction integrity with JTA/Atomikos for wallet and reward systems.
  • Improve system scalability using Spring Boot, Infinispan, and Quartz Scheduler.
  • Write robust, testable code with JUnit 5 and participate in reviews and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with Product, Frontend, and QA teams to deliver reliable releases.
About You
  • 5+ years of backend development experience with Java (17–21).
  • Strong expertise in Spring Boot, Maven, and SQL database design.
  • Experience with distributed systems, multi‑threading, and containerised environments.
  • Familiarity with real‑time multiplayer or gaming backends (matchmaking, wallet logic, scoring).
  • Knowledge of REST APIs, microservice architecture, and network communication.
  • Experience with Infinispan, Quartz Scheduler, or Apache MINA, and an understanding of payment processing, commission/rake models, and gaming compliance.

Mature, mission‑driven, and low‑ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

Job Details

description:
Cargo: Gerente de Projetos (Projeto Restaura Biomas)

Programa/Departamento: Florestas – Uso da Terra

Localização: São Paulo/SP

WRI Brasil está buscando: uma pessoa para gerenciar o Programa Restaura Biomas, um projeto com a Conservação Internacional como agência parceira do Fundo Global para o Meio Ambiente (GEF), sendo o WRI Brasil como agência executora e o Ministério do Meio Ambiente (MMA) como parceiro governamental contribuindo a execução da Política Nacional de Recuperação da Vegetação Nativa (PROVEG) e ao cumprimento de requisitos e objetivos alinhados à estratégia do WRI Brasil e da União Pela Restauração. Este programa faz parte do Programa Integrado de Restauração de Ecossistemas - um programa do GEF em 20 países com mais de 200 milhões de dólares para restauração.

Principais atividades e/ou responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar o projeto Restaura Biomas, assegurando que todos os requisitos sejam cumpridos de acordo com as políticas e procedimentos da Agência CI-GEF e em estreita colaboração com o MMA e União pela Restauração.
  • Coordenar a elaboração do plano de execução do projeto, com base nos objetivos, componentes técnicos, metas e indicadores.
  • Acompanhar e monitorar a execução financeira do orçamento, garantindo a suficiência dos recursos para a execução das atividades conforme o cronograma.
  • Coordenar e acompanhar as entregas e execução financeira por parte dos parceiros técnicos externos nos componentes adicionais do projeto.
  • Responsável por liderar a divulgação do projeto junto a equipe de comunicações.
  • Acompanhamento, monitoramento e elaboração de relatórios em nível institucional e nacional.
  • Construir e manter relações-chave alinhadas com os objetivos do Programa Integrado de Restauração e Ecossistemas.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de estratégias e ferramentas para implementar e monitorar com sucesso o projeto de restauração.
  • Impulsionar o aumento de financiamento e recursos para a restauração.
  • Gestão da equipe, com principal foco em pessoas envolvidas no projeto Restaura Biomas.
  • Coordenar a comunicação e partilha de recursos entre os projetos de restauração.
  • Assegurar o alinhamento do Projeto Restaura Biomas e da estratégia do WRI Brasil.
  • Responsável pela interface e coordenação das ações do projeto junto a agência executora e ao doador do projeto GEF.

Qualificações necessárias:

  • Formação em áreas correlatas aos temas de restauração e/ou conservação de ecossistemas naturais (Engenharia Florestal, Geografia, Biologia, Ecologia, entre outras).
  • Desejável mínimo de 10 anos com gestão de projetos, preferencialmente em organizações sem fins lucrativos.
  • Experiência em gestão de recursos públicos, preferencialmente em projetos GEF.
  • Experiência com publicações científicas, elaboração de relatórios e documentação de projetos.
  • Inglês fluente (boa comunicação escrita e verbal).
  • Excelente capacidade de realizar análises políticas à escala nacional e internacional.
  • Comportamento colaborativo e boas competências de gestão de pessoas e recursos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de fornecer visão e excelentes habilidades de pensamento estratégico.

Experiências que valorizamos:

  • Desejável a capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma, garantindo alto desempenho e entregas consistentes.
  • Visão da agenda de finanças na implementação de mecanismos financeiros para a restauração.
  • Capacidade de articulação multissetorial para engajar diferentes atores em processos de restauração.
  • Experiência na estruturação de mecanismos de pagamento por serviços ambientais.
  • Conhecimento sobre a cadeia da restauração, desde o planejamento até a implementação e monitoramento.
  • Experiência com inserção da restauração em políticas públicas e regulamentações ambientais.
  • Conhecimento sobre bases de dados que possam apoiar a análise de investimentos em restauração.

Salário e Benefícios:

O salário compatível com a experiência e capacitação.

40h/semanais.

Vale transporte.

Vale refeição/alimentação no Cartão Caju.

Programa de Qualidade de Vida.

Day Off de aniversário.

Seguro de vida.

Modelo de trabalho híbrido.

Recesso entre Natal e Ano novo.

Como se inscrever:

Caso você se qualifique para a vaga, inscreva-se online no site até dia 30 de março de 2025. Só serão consideradas no processo de seleção inscrições submetidas por este site.

Promoção da Diversidade:

O WRI Brasil busca incorporar a diversidade em suas ações e projetos. Por isso, se desejar, indique na sua Carta de Intenções informações que julgar relevantes para consideração em sua candidatura.

Sobre o WRI Brasil:

O WRI Brasil é um instituto de pesquisa que trabalha em parceria para gerar transformação. Atua no desenvolvimento de estudos e implementação de soluções para que as pessoas tenham o essencial para viver, para proteger e restaurar a natureza, pelo equilíbrio do clima e por comunidades resilientes.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana .

Desde 2019, o projeto Acolhidos por meio do Trabalho tem sido implementado com o propósito de melhorar as condições de vida e fomentar a dignidade das pessoas refugiadas e migrantes venezuelanas no Brasil. O projeto opera em quatro esferas: a primeira atuando no fortalecimento das capacidades individuais para promover a autonomia, por meio da realização de cursos profissionalizantes e de português destinados à população abrigada; a segunda na facilitação do processo de integração socioeconômica em novas localidades por meio da estratégia de interiorização; a terceira no aprimoramento das condições de vida, saúde e higiene dos venezuelanos abrigados, através de atividades relacionadas à WASH (água, higiene e saneamento); e a quarta esfera se baseia na implementação de um cultivo urbano agroecológio destinado à população indígena abrigada.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

No contexto da estratégia de interiorização, o projeto atua por meio de duas modalidades: Institucional (abrigo-abrigo) e Vaga de Emprego Sinalizada (VES). Nesse âmbito, as atividades desenvolvidas visam à integração socioeconômica de venezuelanos abrigados em Boa Vista em novas localidades do Brasil, com apoio psicossocial e moradia durante um período de três meses.

O (a) Supervisor (a) Operacional será responsável por garantir a estruturação correta dos processos de interiorização nas modalidades de Vaga de Emprego Sinalizada (VES) e Institucional (abrigo-abrigo), bem como pela articulação logística de tais processos, garantindo a execução correta da iniciativa. Além disso, é de atribuição do cargo apoiar no monitoramento de dados das interiorizações realizadas pelo projeto, garantindo que todos os dados estão sendo coletados no prazo estabelecido. Ademais, o (a) supervisor (a) operacional estará incumbido de estabelecer contato com outros atores do projeto e da operação, assegurando a atualização constante de informações com os escritórios de Brasília/DF e Santa Catarina.

Supervisão e auxílio na implementação das atividades de interiorização:

Apoiar em todas as etapas do processo de interiorização Via Vaga de Empredo Sinalizada (VES) e para a Casa Bom Samaritano em Brasília/DF.

Acompanhar a montagem dos processos no sistema acolhedor da Operação Acolhida.

Manter o diálogo e a interação com as empresas parceiras.

Colaborar em questões documentais dos processos.

Articular com os parceiros e demais atores em questões relacionadas à interiorização.

Atualizar as outras partes do projeto baseadas em Brasília e Santa Catarina sobre o andamento dos processos.

Participar de reuniões e demais atividades referentes à interiorização

Monitoramento referente à interiorização:

Acompanhar e coletar todos os dados gerados pelas atividades de interiorização.

Repassar os dados para a pessoa responsável.

Responsibilities
The Global Communications team at TikTok is responsible for all external communications related to the company. We're currently looking for a dynamic senior communications leader to join our fast-paced Global Communications team. As Head of Communications for Latin America, you will be responsible for providing ongoing counsel and partnership to the company's senior leaders across the region, while leading, inspiring and motivating a highly-engaged team.

We're looking for a dynamic leader with strong experience working in the technology industry. At TikTok, our leaders are also doers and you have proven experience conceptualizing, planning, and executing projects that have meaningful business impact. You're able to effectively manage through complex decisions and challenges, using sound judgment and expertise to mitigate risks and ensure the best outcomes. You are familiar with the media, regulatory and policy, as well as competitive landscape across the region and, as such, are able to effectively develop strategies to manage issues and mitigate risk, while ensuring balance between consumer and creative campaigns and reactive response efforts. As a strategic leader, you will work closely with other teams across the Global Brand & Comms department, including Marketing and CSR, as well as with our cross-functional partners — Product, Legal and Public Policy —to create cohesive and compelling communication strategies.

Ideal candidates are resilient, entrepreneurial-minded leaders who work well in an ever-evolving environment. You have strong media relationships. You collaborate with ease across teams and are able to weigh big picture objectives with immediate business needs. You're good at connecting the dots and you thrive in an entrepreneurial environment. And you lead with a compassionate, people-first mindset. This role reports to the Head of Global Corporate Communications.

- Build strong creative consumer campaigns, in partnership with Marketing, that help grow brand affinity.

- Lead and develop a high-performing team, while fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous development.

MISSÃO DO CARGO – SUPERVISOR COLÔNIA DE FÉRIAS

Buscamos Supervisor Operacional que garanta a eficiência e a excelência na operação diária do clube, proporcionando um ambiente seguro, acolhedor e de alta qualidade. REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

- Graduação em Administração ou áreas relacionadas

- Morar na região das Moreninhas

- Experiência prévia em posições de supervisão ou liderança de equipes operacionais

- Familiaridade com as operações e atividades de um clube de lazer, incluindo programas recreativos, esportivos e sociais. Conhecimento básico em questões de segurança, primeiros socorros e gestão de crises

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação, liderança e relacionamento interpessoal.

title: Technical Product Manager (Core)
description:
Job Description

Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already woven into the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

Role Overview
The Core/AI team is responsible for maintaining shared tooling, advancing AI capabilities, and ensuring robust systems and security across all of Luzia’s operations. This role is pivotal in defining and implementing the team’s strategy while driving collaboration with engineering, design, and other cross-functional stakeholders. Your work will impact millions of users globally and set the standards for how Luzia evolves.


You are a perfect fit if you:

Stay up to date with the latest in AI—whether it’s listening to podcasts, following new tech launches, or experimenting with the newest tools. You’re a fast learner who thrives in fast-paced startup environments, where uncertainty is the norm, and there’s no user manual. You’re driven by curiosity and passion—about AI or anything else that excites you—and you’re eager to learn and grow every step of the way. You’re comfortable rolling up your sleeves, figuring things out on the fly, and don’t shy away from talking to anyone in the organization to make things happen. If you’ve integrated AI into your daily life and know how to turn curiosity into action, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work with the head of engineering to design and execute a vision for Luzia’s foundational systems and AI capabilities.

  • Align the core team efforts with business goals, ensuring a robust and scalable architecture.

  • Collaborate with engineering and other product teams to develop features around memory, inference optimization, advanced system prompts, customization and AI-enhanced workflows

  • Lead the prioritization and execution of tasks based on the Core/AI team’s operating model.

  • Continuously seek ways to optimize our core systems based on key metrics

  • Develop and maintain robust product documentation and requirements that improve internal processes and help to provide scope for engineering development.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 5+ years in a technical product management role, preferably with experience in AI or core infrastructure teams.

  • Strong understanding of software development, AI technologies, and system architecture.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up sleeves to get the job done.

  • Skilled at working effectively with cross-functional teams and ability to influence.

  • Experience gathering business requirements, defining product requirements and using business intelligence tools (SQL, Amplitude, Looker, Braze) to extract data, formulate metrics, and build reports.

  • Experience leading multiple projects with multiple stakeholders within tight timelines

  • Extreme attention to detail, design and UX.

  • Genuine user-centric and data-driven mindsets.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Full professional proficiency in English. Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.


Work Environment:

As a young startup, we offer the excitement and agility of a startup culture with the backing of prominent investors in one of the hottest and most relevant industries. We prioritize action and innovation, and we're looking for a driven individual ready to step up to challenges and grow with us. We are prepared to change the world.


Our Culture and Values

Get shit done, Keep it simple, Embrace the pain, are some of our operating principles. At Luzia, we live and breathe agility and ownership. Our culture is steeped in a "ship, experiment, iterate, ship" mentality, where extreme ownership action, innovation and rapid execution are paramount.


Growth and Impact

In a world where artificial intelligence technology is evolving at breakneck speed, every task completed contributes to our growth, and every problem solved brings us one step closer to our vision. As Product Manager, your work will impact not only the future of Luzia AI, but also the lives of millions of users around the world.

Realizar consultas compartilhadas com equipe multidisciplinar;

Registrar as informações e atendimentos em formulários próprios e/ou sistemas informatizados;

Realizar outras atribuições descritas na Lei nº 4.119/62 e suas alterações, Decreto nº 53.464/64,diretrizes na Regulamentação da Profissão, expedida pelo Conselho Federal de Psicologia, bem como às demais normas emitidas pelo Conselho Federal de Psicologia (CFP), Conselho Regional de Psicologia (CRP), Normas Regulamentadoras do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego (NR’s) e legislação vigente aplicável.

Cursos de formação, capacitação e/ou aperfeiçoamento, realizados nos últimos 2 anos em: Primeiros socorros psicológicos, atendimento em crise emocional e/ou atendimento a vítimas de violência.

Conhecimento e/ou experiência comprovada nos conceitos de atendimento em saúde do trabalhador dentro de organizações e/ou atuação em equipe multidisciplinar no atendimento em saúde mental e promoção da saúde.

title: Gerente de Marketing
description:
Job description

Sobre a Memed

A Memed é a healthtech líder em prescrição digital no Brasil, revolucionando a forma como médicos, pacientes e a indústria farmacêutica se conectam.

Nosso propósito é claro: simplificar o acesso à informação médica e elevar a qualidade do atendimento em saúde.

Com nossas soluções digitais, impactamos milhões de vidas todos os meses e contribuímos para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, seguro e humano. Nossa plataforma de receita digital inteligente já transformou a jornada de milhares de médicos e pacientes em todo o país.

Se você acredita que a tecnologia pode transformar a medicina e a experiência do paciente, o seu lugar é aqui.

O impacto do seu trabalho

Você será responsável por liderar a estratégia de Marketing da Memed , conectando propósito, marca e crescimento de negócios.

Como Gerente de Marketing , seu desafio será desenhar e executar uma estratégia integrada que una comunicação institucional, performance e posicionamento de marca — fortalecendo a presença da Memed no ecossistema de saúde e impulsionando resultados tangíveis.

Buscamos uma pessoa estrategista, criativa e orientada a resultados , com forte capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica, capaz de traduzir dados e insights em ações que ampliem o alcance, relevância e impacto da marca.

Main responsibilities
  • Estruturar e liderar a área de Marketing, definindo estratégia, processos e prioridades para o crescimento sustentável da marca.
  • Posicionar a empresa como referência em prescrição digital e inovação em saúde, fortalecendo sua autoridade institucional e conexão com o ecossistema médico, farmacêutico e tecnológico.
  • Desenhar e evoluir a máquina de geração de demanda, orquestrando o funil completo awareness, aquisição, ativação e retenção, com foco em previsibilidade e eficiência.
  • Conectar branding, performance e dados, garantindo coerência entre campanhas, conteúdo e métricas de negócio.
  • Definir, acompanhar e otimizar indicadores-chave (CAC, LTV, ROI, pipeline de leads, NPS), utilizando dados como base para decisões estratégicas.
  • Liderar estratégias de CRM e automação, aprimorando a jornada de relacionamento com profissionais de saúde, pacientes e parceiros.
  • Gerir canais de mídia e performance digital, assegurando relevância e consistência em todas as frentes de comunicação.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de eventos e ativações de marca, ampliando a presença e autoridade institucional em conferências, feiras e fóruns do setor.
  • Atuar de forma transversal com Produto, Growth, Vendas e Customer Success, garantindo alinhamento nas iniciativas de go-to-market.
  • Formar e inspirar o time de Marketing, cultivando uma cultura de autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e colaboração.
Requirements and skills
  • Formação superior completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em marketing estratégico e growth, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia, saúde ou negócios digitais.
  • Vivência com modelos B2C, B2B e B2B2C.
  • Capacidade de unir pensamento analítico e sensibilidade de marca.
  • Visão de funil completo e domínio de métricas de performance e crescimento.
  • Habilidade para transitar entre o estratégico e o operacional, com mentalidade colaborativa e foco em resultado.
  • Excelente comunicação, com capacidade de influenciar diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Paixão por inovação em saúde e por construir marcas que geram impacto real na jornada do cuidado.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Marketing, Growth ou Comunicação Estratégica.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor da saúde, compreendendo o ecossistema de profissionais, pacientes e parceiros.
  • Vivência em healthtechs, empresas farmacêuticas, clínicas digitais ou plataformas médicas será considerada um grande diferencial.

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

  • Aplicar técnicas estatísticas para demonstrar a situação metrológica dos equipamentos de medição (Cálculos de incerteza tipo A e Tipo B);
  • Demonstrar a confiabilidade metrologia nos seus respectivos processos, cadastrar instrumentos de medições com sua característica de engenharia e metrológica. Mater atualizado o controle eletrônico dos instrumentos quanto a situação metrológica;

  • Auxiliar na Configuração de equipamentos de medição por meio Software durante instalação/utilização, de acordo com os requisitos requeridos para aplicação;
  • Planejar estudos dos sistemas de medição (MSA);
  • Acompanhar estabilidades dos equipamentos medição de acordo com necessidades do processo;

  • Auxiliar na nas manutenções de instrumentos de pesagens.

title: AUXILIAR TÉCNICO (OFICINEIRO) - CAPS
description:
Join to apply for the AUXILIAR TÉCNICO (OFICINEIRO) - CAPS role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

O CAPS é um serviço destinado a acolher e acompanhar pacientes com transtornos mentais graves, através de atendimento integral que visa estimular e apoiar os usuários em suas iniciativas de busca da autonomia, acesso ao trabalho, lazer, exercício dos direitos civis e fortalecimento dos laços familiares e comunitários.

As equipes são compostas de Médico, Psicólogo, Enfermeiro, Assistente Social, Educador Físico, Psicopedagogo e Terapeuta Ocupacional, dentre outros profissionais.

As atividades contam com atendimentos individuais, ações coletivas, oficinas terapêuticas e ações de articulação junto aos demais Serviços de Saúde da rede e de outros setores (Educação, Cultura, Lazer, Esporte, Assistência Social).

Os atendimentos são voltados ao público adulto (CAPS Adulto), pacientes com dependência química (CAPS Álcool e Drogas) e crianças e jovens (CAPS Infanto-juvenil), e não há necessidade de encaminhamento para ser atendido.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Cumprir rotinas, normas e regulamentações da Instituição e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde;
  • Seguir os protocolos assistenciais estabelecidos para a Unidade;
  • Comunicar ao Gestor imediato as ocorrências de não conformidades;
  • Registrar as ações de produção em planilhas;
  • Elaborar relatórios;
  • Participar das Comissões internas e externas da Unidade;
  • Participar de eventos de formação, atualização e integração da rede, promovidos pela Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e Instituição;
  • Contribuir para a interação da equipe, nos aspectos técnico e relacional;
  • Participar, conforme necessário, juntamente ao técnico responsável, do acolhimento;
  • Coordenar e participar de oficinas, grupos e outras atividades que se fizerem necessárias conforme área de atuação;
  • Realizar visitas domiciliares;
  • Realizar a referência de caso compartilhado com equipe;
  • Levantar e manter atualizado o perfil do território de inserção da unidade;
  • Propor, promover e participar, ativamente, de reuniões de articulação com a rede, discussões de casos e do processo de trabalho, atendimento compartilhado, ações intersetoriais no território, que contribua no processo de cogestão e corresponsabilização no agenciamento do projeto terapêutico singular da população atendida;
  • Registrar em prontuário todas as informações pertinentes relacionadas à identificação, com data, hora, assinatura e carimbo e, condutas pertinentes a cada intervenção;
  • Acolher e encaminhar os usuários e seus familiares para outros profissionais da unidade ou outros serviços de acordo com a demanda;
  • Prestar atendimento ao usuário em situação de violência, risco e de vulnerabilidade social, notificando os órgãos competentes;
  • Acompanhar o processo de alta e inserção em outro serviço;
  • Contatar os órgãos competentes para providenciar remoções de usuários que necessitem de encaminhamento para outros serviços;
  • Orientar, através de métodos específicos, toda a equipe da unidade, profissionais da rede e grupos populacionais quanto aos procedimentos específicos de sua área de atuação;
  • Zelar por todos os equipamentos, materiais e documentos pertinentes da unidade;
  • Realizar provisão, solicitação e zelar pelos bens de consumo e permanentes utilizados nas oficinas e grupos de sua responsabilidade;
  • Acompanhar os usuários em atividades e rotinas diárias na unidade, inclusive na ambiência;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD;
  • Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Com empreendimentos que marcam a cidade de São Paulo — como o Platina 220 e o Hospital São Luiz Anália Franco — a Porte atua com um olhar integrado sobre a cidade, unindo moradia, trabalho, cultura, mobilidade e saúde em soluções que inspiram uma nova forma de viver. Somos guiados pela ética, inovação e excelência técnica e acreditamos que cada projeto é uma oportunidade de construir um futuro mais sustentável, conectado e humano. description:
Managing Director (D2C product)

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products across health, education, and entertainment industries. Our teams drive the future of consumer‑led products and we’re looking for a passionate leader to join us.

About the Role

We are creating a new D2C subscription product and are looking for a Managing Director to oversee day‑to‑day operations, drive execution, and build a world‑class team.

Profit Share

This role comes with a generous profit‑sharing incentive and stock options, with details shared during the interview.

The Team

Build a high‑talent, fast‑paced team in a 100% remote environment.

About You

You are a dynamic, hands‑on leader with extensive experience in D2C digital products (subscriptions preferred). You excel at driving growth and innovation, with deep expertise in engineering, product, marketing, and growth strategy. You are comfortable leading cross‑functional teams, managing teams, delivering results under pressure, and deeply engaging in the technical and operational aspects of the business.

What You’ll Do
  • Lead the company's strategic growth by developing and executing initiatives that drive business expansion, optimize market positioning, and advance overall progress.
  • Lead cross‑functional teams in executing complex strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment across engineering, product development, growth, marketing, and sales.
  • Drive revenue growth and profitability while optimizing operational expenses.
  • Oversee the product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring products meet market needs and quality standards.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions that align with customer expectations and business goals.
  • Ensure that the product roadmap is aligned with business strategy and customer feedback.
  • Oversee marketing campaigns, ensuring they are data‑driven, customer‑centric, and aligned with product launches and sales strategies.
  • Utilize data analytics to refine and optimize growth strategies, ensuring sustainable revenue growth.
  • Continuously monitor and analyze key financial and operational metrics, such as revenue growth, EBITDA margins, and customer acquisition costs (CAC).
  • Evaluate customer lifetime value (LTV) and return on ad spend (ROAS) to optimize marketing efficiency and resource allocation.
  • Track onboarding conversion rates to identify areas for improvement in user experience and increase customer activation, analyze average revenue per user (ARPU) and user retention rates to inform product development and enhance long‑term profitability.
Qualifications
  • Dynamic, hands‑on leadership with extensive D2C digital product experience (subscription preferred).
  • Deep understanding of engineering, product, marketing, and growth strategies.
  • Experience leading cross‑functional teams and executing strategic initiatives.
  • Ability to optimize performance and deliver results under pressure.
  • Comfortable engaging deeply in technical and operational aspects of the business.
What We Offer
  • Remote Work Environment: Flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Stock options and revenue sharing for the CM/Managing Director role.
  • Company‑provided MacBook to support productivity.
Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply as long as they are within approximately ± 4 hours of CET to ensure optimal collaboration.

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we review it in 3–5 days. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with:

  • Recruiter screening (40 minutes)
  • Final interview (60 minutes)
Life at Ruby Labs

We move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small – we build, grow, and win. We look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every day. If you thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen. Effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all‑in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more – more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

description:
At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.

Overview

Job Title: Director, Legal Counsel

Company: Prologis

Location: São Paulo-SP, Brazil

Direct Report: VP, Legal Counsel

Day in the life

Prologis is seeking a senior legal counsel to join its Brazil legal team based in São Paulo, working under the supervision and leadership of the local VP Legal Counsel. We welcome highly qualified candidates with extensive experience, a broad-based, solutions-oriented legal background, and a practical, hands-on approach, together with the ability to independently lead all legal aspects of sophisticated real estate transactions, environmental matters, leasing (including BTSs), litigation, and property management, while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, regulatory frameworks, and contractual obligations.

This individual will be a key member of the legal team - a savvy business attorney who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment providing sound, practical legal advice in a broad range of activities associated with owning, developing, financing, and operating real estate platforms. Contrary to a passive oversight role, the selected candidate will be a hands-on practitioner and trusted advisor at the forefront of sophisticated real estate deals, proactively negotiating and closing some of the most complex real estate transactions and lease agreements in the industry. Their work will directly impact Prologis’ growth and expansion, with a focus on bringing agility and internalizing expertise across the entire platform.

This attorney will play a key role in internalizing legal expertise related to all aspects of a sophisticated real estate platform, including acquisitions, built-to-suit projects, and strategic ventures. They will support the entire platform across the full project lifecycle.

The role also involves integrating new Prologis business lines into the real estate framework, ensuring alignment between operations and customer relationships. The attorney will be customer-facing, supporting and coordinating the business platforms including contract enforcement and monitoring condominium rules compliance, as well as engaging external litigation counsel.

Responsibilities
  • Lead legal due diligence, identify and mitigate risks, and structure solutions protect Prologis’ interests.
  • Review transaction documents to assure Prologis interests are appropriately addressed
  • Draft and negotiate all real estate related agreements including easements, leases, construction and development agreements, condominium bylaws, cost-sharing agreements, and service agreements.
  • Structure and quarterback built-to-suit transactions, ensuring smooth closings and transition to the development team.
  • Oversee title, survey, and condominium matters, coordinating external resources as needed.
  • Support and drive legal aspects of entitlements, land use, power procurement and related filings.
  • Manage outside counsel on litigation, entitlements, taxation, and property management.
  • Select and manage outside counsel, including fee proposals and agreements.
  • Anticipate and address emerging legal challenges as Prologis’ business platform evolves.
Education

title: Product Director - Cross-Border Payments
description:
Company Description

Visa is a world leader in payments and technology, with over 259 billion payments transactions flowing safely between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities in more than 200 countries and territories each year. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive while driven by a common purpose – to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Make an impact with a purpose-driven industry leader. Join us today and experience Life at Visa.

Job Description

Product Director – Crossborder Payments

Cross-border payments are a strategic pillar for global financial inclusion and digital commerce. As the Director of Product for Cross-Border Payments, you will lead the development and execution of product strategies that enable seamless international transactions for consumers and businesses. This role is pivotal in shaping the future of remittances, B2B payments, and global e-commerce enablement in Brazil.

You will work across functions—Product, Strategy, Compliance, Partnerships, Engineering, and Marketing—to deliver innovative, scalable, and compliant solutions. You will also engage with regulators, financial institutions, fintechs, and global merchants to drive adoption and market growth.

Responsibilities
  • Define and evolve the cross-border payments product vision and roadmap for Brazil, aligned with global strategy.
  • Monitor regulatory developments, FX trends, and emerging technologies (e.g., blockchain, digital wallets, DCC).
  • Lead market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and threats.
  • Collaborate with compliance and legal teams to ensure regulatory alignment (e.g., BACEN, AML, KYC).
  • Develop business cases for new product initiatives and enhancements.
  • Launch and scale cross-border payment products for pay-in and payout use cases.
  • Build partnerships with banks, fintechs, PSPs, and global platforms (e.g., marketplaces, gig economy).
  • Drive integration of APIs and data assets to enable real-time, low-cost, and secure transactions.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver product features, documentation, and training.
  • Represent the company in industry forums and regulatory discussions.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in payments, FX, or financial services, with at least 5 years in product leadership.
  • Proven track record of launching and scaling payment products in Brazil or LATAM.
  • Strong understanding of cross-border payment flows, FX settlement, and treasury operations.
  • Experience working in matrixed organizations with global and regional teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks for international payments in Brazil.
  • Strong network within the payments ecosystem (banks, fintechs, regulators).
  • Ability to anticipate market trends and translate them into actionable strategy.
  • Multilingual (Portuguese and English required, Spanish is a plus).
Additional Information

Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours.

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that 'makes sense' to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month. 25 hrs a week. Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via (contact) with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

description:
Join to apply for the Chief Architect LATAM (Brazil) role at Red Hat .

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

This Chief Architect position will focus on enterprise-scale commercial companies and organizations in Latin America.

Successful candidates will bring experience in broad technology architecture, in one or more industries, in both traditional and emerging IT practices. Candidates should have a strong knowledge of Red Hat’s portfolio of offerings and differentiation in the competitive technology landscape.

The selected candidate will be expected to gain an understanding of and ability to represent Red Hat’s research and emerging technology areas. Chief Architects support Red Hat’s sales process through the creation, curation, and education of common patterns, defined through interactions with the broad set of customers and ecosystem of partners. While Chief Architects are engaged in the sales process, the role prioritizes engaging in relationships built on trust and exchange of mutually beneficial value, not on closing sales.

What You Will Do
  • Represent Red Hat’s strategic message in meetings and briefings with customers, Executive Briefing Center (EBC) sessions, professional and technology communities, interviews with media analysts, and on stage at public events.
  • Understand and articulate the innovative vision and business requirements of customers and partners, identify the drivers and opportunities for working with Red Hat, and provide technical and business value guidance in alignment with the Red Hat portfolio and ecosystem of partner offerings.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert to Red Hat’s Technical Sales community in a specific geography, industry, or technology area, leveraging the library of architectural patterns to create Sales, Support, and Engineering efficiencies.
  • Aggregate, define and capture valuable insights and efforts produced during engagements with customers, partners, and communities as reusable patterns, including code, configuration, documentation, and enablement in written and video formats.
  • Represent the aggregate voice of enterprise customers as part of Red Hat’s strategic planning processes, using verified and documented stories from customer and community engagements to help justify proposed investments.
  • Enable the use of Open Source community practices as a model for collaboration inside and outside Red Hat.
  • Review complex technical architectures when requested by Solution Architects in the field, helping validate technical and business aspects of the proposed solution.
What You Will Bring
  • Ability to communicate clearly and confidently in spoken, written, and visual forms, both live and recorded, at scale ranging from individual conversations with executives and media to large public audiences.
  • Ability to discover and understand functional business requirements across various industries and map back to appropriate technologies and practices from Red Hat and across our ecosystem of partners.
  • Ability to define and describe complex domain architecture from a logical, functional, and technical perspective, and document these architectures using tools that support both reuse of the pattern and deployment according to common GitOps/DevOps practices.
  • Ability to capture and collaborate on reusable architectural patterns, in formats ranging across written documentation, slides, diagrams, code, and/or configurations, using tools appropriate for the type of architecture, format, and audience.
  • Strong understanding of open source and community models of collaboration.
  • Act as technical leaders demonstrating those qualities Red Hat values in field-facing staff, providing mentorship, and continuously improving the organization.
  • Spanish or Portuguese speaker and proficient in English.
Experience Required
  • Hands-on knowledge of Red Hat’s product portfolio in development or production scenarios.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate in teams and across teams, building relationships based on trust and sharing of knowledge.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve meaningful problems using multiple technologies and practices, and document and communicate the solution to a team/organization for sustainment and reuse.
About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and plugging! The email marketing channel is a strong focus for us, and if you get a thrill from optimizing flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground.

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Whoop whoop!

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed ) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimizing flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness. Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you ‑ running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should.

The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month. 25 hrs a week. Managed via Upwork.

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle.

I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, Lena.

description:
Location: São Paulo (remote working)

Substack is building a new global economic engine for culture, giving the most creative and interesting people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack’s model—based on direct subscriptions—has fueled an explosion of independent publishing, empowering creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences.

We’re hiring a Head of Creator Partnerships for Brazil to lead and scale the Brazilian Substack business. Working alongside our Head of Europe, you’ll be responsible for building awareness of the Substack brand in Brazil, onboarding the country’s most exciting independent talent, as well as helping to tell the Substack story to creators and consumers across the country.

This is a pivotal role for an exceptional leader who has a strong track record of business growth as well as nurturing creative talent across all mediums. You’ll also be a strategic thinker who is as comfortable working with big political names as you are with smaller, less well‑known creators. Knowledge of events and being comfortable speaking publicly is a bonus.

What You’ll Do
  • With the help of Substack’s Head of Europe, develop and execute a strategy for onboarding influential creators, helping them build successful subscription businesses and vibrant communities on Substack.
  • Own key growth metrics around creator acquisition, retention, revenue, and engagement—aligning impact with Substack’s broader business goals.
  • Build and deepen relationships with creators, talent managers, studios, agencies, tastemakers, and the press to expand Substack’s presence in the cultural ecosystem.
  • Champion Brazilian creators internally by synthesizing their needs, motivations, and ambitions into product, support, and partnership opportunities.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with Product, Data, Marketing, and Communications to evolve the Brazilian creator experience and improve outreach and feature adoption.
  • Represent Substack externally—on stage, in the press, and in key industry rooms—positioning the company as the premier platform for independent creative work.
  • Stay ahead of creator economy trends, emerging formats, and shifting audience behaviors to keep Substack on the leading edge in Brazil.
What We’re Looking For
  • 7+ years of experience as a leader in creator partnerships, talent development, business development or editorial.
  • Proven success leading and scaling teams in fast‑paced environments with high agency and ownership.
  • Deep empathy for creators and an understanding of the challenges and opportunities they face when building independent careers.
  • A robust network across the creator economy—including relationships with top creators, talent agencies, production companies, digital media leaders and journalists.
  • A demonstrable and exceptional understanding of the Brazilian ‘creator’ market.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, often on a public stage, is a bonus.

Compensation: Substack’s compensation package includes a market‑competitive salary, equity for all full‑time roles, and exceptional benefits. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.
